title: lycopersicon esculentum subsp. typicum
intro: Lycopersicon esculentum subsp. typicum, commonly known as the wild tomato, is a subspecies of the Lycopersicon esculentum plant. It is a plant that belongs to the nightshade family and is native to the Americas. The wild tomato has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Lycopersicon esculentum subsp. typicum include carotenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
